# Claw Command Officer Standard Operating Procedure
Officers respond directly to the heads of staff. Their purpose is to aid, assist, defend and sometimes serve the crew wherever possible. In case their time is not requested by command they are encouraged to assist and help defend the crew while not staying too far away from command members. Officers are 2nd rank command roles. Officers follow the same SOP and escalation methods for violence, arrests and weapons as security does. Officers should seek to do sec work when security does not have an abundant amount of officers, It is not standard operation for officers to wear security belts, this should only be needed in case of a understaffed security. Officers cannot become acting captain unless there is no other command onboard member, once such member arrives they have to hand over acting captain.
